description: Domain-specific financial and lending clause taxonomy for loan agreements and amendments.

entries.text: Revolving credit clause: Establishes a revolving credit facility with a commitment amount, borrowing base mechanics, and availability terms. Often references borrowing requests, base rate margins, and commitment reductions.

standard_language_patterns: lender agrees to make revolving loans
metadata.notes: Common in commercial lending. Amendment documents may reference parent commitments by incorporation.

entries.text: Quarterly commitment reduction clause: Requires scheduled reductions of revolving commitment or principal over defined quarterly dates.

standard_language_patterns: on the last day of each quarter
metadata.notes: Can create liquidity pressure when paired with strict covenants.

entries.text: Collateral and security interest clause: Grants or reaffirms liens, mortgages, pledges, and security interests securing lender obligations.

standard_language_patterns: grant a first priority security interest
metadata.notes: Frequently updated in amendments when additional collateral is granted.

entries.text: Event of default clause in lending: Defines triggers such as payment default, covenant breach, insolvency, cross-default, and acceleration rights.

standard_language_patterns: lender may declare immediately due and payable
metadata.notes: Default definitions should be evaluated with cure periods.

entries.text: Conditions precedent clause for amendment effectiveness: Lists documents, approvals, fees, and certifications required before amendment takes effect.

standard_language_patterns: this amendment shall become effective when
metadata.notes: Missing fulfillment can delay funding or nullify amendment effectiveness.

entries.text: Guaranty agreement clause: Captures guarantor obligations, guarantee scope, waivers, and continuing nature of guaranty.

metadata.notes: Waiver and unconditional language materially increase guarantor exposure.

entries.text: Financial covenant clause: Imposes leverage, fixed-charge coverage, liquidity, interest coverage, and reporting ratio thresholds.

metadata.notes: Threshold calibration drives compliance and default risk.

entries.text: Loan fee clause: Specifies origination fees, commitment fees, amendment fees, and fee calculation basis.

standard_language_patterns: borrower shall pay a fee equal to
metadata.notes: Fee base (full commitment vs incremental amount) materially impacts cost.

entries.text: Borrowing base clause: Ties availability to collateral value, concentration limits, and eligibility criteria.

standard_language_patterns: availability shall equal the borrowing base
metadata.notes: Frequent source of liquidity fluctuations and compliance disputes.

entries.text: Release of claims clause in banking context: Borrower releases lender from known and unknown claims related to loan documents and relationship.

standard_language_patterns: borrower hereby releases and forever discharges
metadata.notes: Broad release language can waive future disputes and litigation rights.
